item.title: Las Vegas Grand Prix Delivers 50 Laps of Close Battles While Verstappen Holds On to Win
item.description: Verstappen won in Vegas for the third time in four years, but with 35 lead changes and 352 overtakes, the Las Vegas Grand Prix was far from ordinary.
